entities.name: Marjorie Courtenay-Latimer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marjorie Eileen Doris Courtenay-Latimer was a South African museum official, who in 1938, brought the existence of the coelacanth, a fish thought to have been extinct for 65 million years, to the attention of the world.
